text_blocks: Glitter is no longer just for special occasions – it's for every day! From glittery eyeshadow to sparkly highlighter, this trend is all about adding some sparkle to your look. Don't be afraid to shine!
Neon lips are taking over for 2030! This trend is all about bright, bold colors that pop. Whether you prefer hot pinks or electric oranges, there's a neon shade for everyone.

The 'no-makeup' makeup trend is here to stay for 2030! This trend is all about enhancing your natural beauty with a few subtle touches. Think sheer lip tints, light coverage foundation, and a touch of bronzer for a sun-kissed glow.
